integrity: Complete analytic upper and lower bounds are given; finite calculations independently test instances; originality assessments are subject to incomplete historical indexing.
scientific_limitations: Only h=12k+11 with 5 not dividing k+1, or 5 dividing k+1 and 7 not dividing k+1. Cases with 35 dividing k+1 are open in this analysis; finite checks do not certify the infinite theorem.
title: Two exact odd-order strata for signed three-element additive bases
